svg.title: About, toolbox, exploring and terminal cards
svg.desc: A little about me: I make servers boring so everything else can be exciting. Interested in algorithms, infrastructure, and the occasional existential crisis caused by a missing semicolon. The toolbox: AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Python. Currently exploring: cloud architecture, DevOps and automation, Python scripting, AI and ML. A terminal joke: git blame --who-broke-prod answers fatal: it was me. again. Then git commit -m fixed it (don't touch), and kubectl get coffee answers No resources found.
